# xanweb/active_cookie_consent_third_party

> 标签: Active Cookie Consent, cookie consent, googlemaps, vimeo, youtube

## 简介

Add Support for ThirdParty Cookie Control

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。
